pins.title: Digital water governance at scale
pins.desc: Co-developed with the Government of Honduras, Agua de Honduras provides a digital platform for water-resource management covering 44 percent of the country. The platform has supported the legalization of 110 watershed management councils, strengthening community participation in water governance.

pins.title: Taking climate information the last mile
pins.desc: Working with Guatemala's Ministry of Agriculture and national meteorological services, CGIAR supported development of a National Framework for Climate Services and co-created delivery mechanisms bringing tailored climate information to farmers across five departments and 176 communities.

pins.title: Lower-emissions cattle production
pins.desc: A CGIAR-supported cattle ranch in Colombia achieved 44 percent lower emissions through sustainable grazing practices. The approach attracted US$7.5 million in private investment to support scaling.
